opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject to a UK institution, normally resident in the UK, not in full-time permanent academic employment, and current members of the Royal Historical Society. Current doctoral students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £2,000 for discrete research projects lasting no more than six months, supporting career-building research or activities post-PhD to produce a discrete outcome such as an article or book proposal.

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD in African history. Those previously awarded the Scholarship not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of £1,500 to support the doctoral research of a postgraduate researcher in African history.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Historians who are members of the Royal Historical Society and who are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (i.e. more than 5 years on from PhD completion).
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to support historians without access to research funding to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend academic conferences.

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants, 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject, who are current members of the Royal Historical Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable early career historians to undertake research activities essential to their projects, including visiting archives, historic sites, and conducting research interviews.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants, 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives, historic sites, and conducting interviews.

opportunities.title: David Berry Fellowship in the History of Scotland and the Scottish People
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society at all career stages from PhD research and beyond.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of up to £2,500 to undertake research on the history of Scotland and the Scottish people worldwide, and to cover associated research costs.

opportunities.title: RHS Workshop Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead organisers who are current Fellows or members of the Royal Historical Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £1,000 to enable historians to come together for a day workshop to pursue projects of shared interest, including research discussion, teaching development, and networking.
